captures.description: THE KNOWLEDGE BASE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'Wikidata is a free, open, and collaborative multilingual knowledge graph hosted by the Wikimedia Foundation. It serves as a central storage hub for structured data used by Wikipedia, Wikimedia sister projects, and external applications.' Key Features: CC0 ('All data is released'); 'Q-number' items ('`Q42` for Douglas Adams') and P-numbers ('`P69` for "educated at"'); statements and triples with references; multilingual labels, descriptions and aliases; the SPARQL Query Service. Eight cards: Wikidata (two), Wikipedia, the Query Service, GitHub, three YouTube videos.
